newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Spring back vs bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Spring back vs bloc.

text.p: The Australian bond market bounced back against its dollar bloc partners after Friday's crushing sell-off was seen as grossly overdone.

The market rallied after the U.S. PPI proved weaker than expectations, and although the move was initially exaggerated by roll over activity in futures, differentials generally remained tighter on the day after the March bond contracts had expired.

The U.S. also firmed after the U.S. PPI came in down 0.4 percent, and although this took the edge off fears of an imminent tightening in Fed policy, the debate over a possible hike in interest rates is expected to continue up until the Federal Open Market Committee on March 25.
In the absence of any key Australian data until after Easter, the local market will remain tied to moves in the U.S., particularly in view of this Wednesday's U.S. CPI.
